replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, especially when I think about complex equations or exams. My high neuroticism makes me overthink, and low agreeableness means I don't always feel supported, so math can feel stressful even if I try to stay calm.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven't used AI much for math, but I tried a chatbot once to explain a concept. It helped a little, but I got frustrated when it didn't understand my questions, so I stopped relying on it and went back to books or videos.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data by finding patterns through math. The math involves linear algebra, but you don't need to do it by hand — tools do it for you. Anxiety isn't necessary; it's just a way to simplify complexity.
